tagline: International representation body for inland waterway transport, shipping, insurance and classification
hero_kpi_rationale: The association's international reach is measured by the number of participants at its annual congresses, reflecting engagement from the European inland navigation sector and IVR's representativeness among shipowners, insurers, and classification experts.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participants

kpis.description: Indicator of the association's engagement and international reach, measuring actual participation in annual strategic meetings.
kpis.signal: 225 participants from 11 countries at the 2024 Annual Congress in Frankfurt am Main (May 15-17, 2024)

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participants
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the first edition of the inland waterway loss prevention colloquium, a key technical event organized by IVR.
kpis.description: Participation in the inaugural IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium, a key technical and professional event for the inland navigation sector.
kpis.signal: 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands and Germany at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp (November 4, 2024)
